answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the meadow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The horizon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the sonnet. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit.
